question: Are official or first-party historical funding sources sufficiently reproducible, documented and complete to support a later no-direction-change Spot/Perp Router backtest?

hyperliquid_info_api.role: native venue field/sign/interval validation and historical-coverage probe

required_checks: enumerate archive symbols without relying on current exchangeInfo
enumerate first/last and missing internal Binance funding months for each target
download first/middle/latest available Binance ZIP samples
record CSV filenames, columns, row counts, timestamp field, rate field and observed interval
record funding-rate sign distribution without interpreting strategy profitability
query fixed Hyperliquid early and recent windows
record response fields, earliest/latest timestamps, row count and observed interval
verify positive-rate long-pays-short convention against official venue documentation in the formal result
write machine-readable coverage and sample evidence

success_gate.binance: All five target symbols must have parseable monthly funding archives covering their actual perpetual lifetime, with explicit gaps reported rather than silently filled.
success_gate.hyperliquid: The native API must return parseable fundingHistory for at least the recent fixed window; early-window absence is allowed and must be reported.

prohibited: no interpolation across missing funding events
no assumption that Binance funding equals Hyperliquid funding
no post-result source substitution under this audit ID
next_experiment_rule: Only after this audit passes may a separately preregistered FUNDING-PNL experiment apply observed funding to frozen historical holdings without changing directional targets.
